hypertension.typical_presentation: Elevated blood pressure, often asymptomatic; may include headache, dizziness, shortness of breath
hypertension.notes: Leading risk factor for stroke, heart attack, and kidney disease

heart_failure.typical_presentation: Shortness of breath, fatigue, leg swelling, reduced exercise tolerance
heart_failure.notes: NSAIDs antagonize diuretics and ACE inhibitors; major cause of decompensation

coronary_artery_disease.typical_presentation: Angina (chest pain with exertion), shortness of breath, fatigue
coronary_artery_disease.notes: NSAIDs increase cardiovascular event risk; diclofenac has highest risk

atrial_fibrillation.typical_presentation: Irregular heartbeat, palpitations, shortness of breath, fatigue, increased stroke risk
atrial_fibrillation.notes: 5-fold increased stroke risk; anticoagulation is cornerstone of management

hyperlipidemia.typical_presentation: Asymptomatic; elevated cholesterol on lab testing
hyperlipidemia.notes: Major modifiable risk factor for cardiovascular disease

asthma.typical_presentation: Wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, coughing (especially at night)
asthma.notes: NSAIDs can trigger severe attacks in AERD patients (Samter's triad)

copd.typical_presentation: Chronic cough, sputum production, progressive shortness of breath
copd.notes: Smoking is primary cause; leading cause of morbidity worldwide

allergic_rhinitis.typical_presentation: Sneezing, runny nose, nasal congestion, itchy eyes
allergic_rhinitis.notes: Common; can significantly impact quality of life

diabetes_type_2.typical_presentation: Increased thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, blurred vision, slow wound healing
diabetes_type_2.notes: Leading cause of kidney failure, blindness, and non-traumatic amputations

hypothyroidism.typical_presentation: Fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, constipation, depression
hypothyroidism.notes: Very common; untreated can cause myxedema coma in severe cases

gastroesophageal_reflux_disease.typical_presentation: Heartburn, regurgitation, chest pain, chronic cough
gastroesophageal_reflux_disease.notes: Chronic untreated GERD can lead to Barrett's esophagus and esophageal cancer

peptic_ulcer_disease.typical_presentation: Burning stomach pain, bloating, nausea, may be asymptomatic
peptic_ulcer_disease.notes: H. pylori infection and NSAIDs are primary causes; can lead to bleeding/perforation

ibs.typical_presentation: Abdominal pain, bloating, altered bowel habits (diarrhea, constipation, or mixed)
ibs.notes: Chronic condition; symptom triggers vary by patient

chronic_kidney_disease.typical_presentation: Often asymptomatic until advanced; fatigue, swelling, changes in urination
avoid_or_caution: Many drugs requiring renal dose adjustment
chronic_kidney_disease.notes: NSAIDs are particularly dangerous in CKD; many medications require dose adjustment

nephrolithiasis.typical_presentation: Flank pain, blood in urine, nausea, painful urination
nephrolithiasis.notes: Calcium oxalate most common type; hydration is key preventive measure

depression.typical_presentation: Persistent low mood, loss of interest, fatigue, sleep/appetite changes, thoughts of self-harm
depression.notes: Leading cause of disability worldwide; can be life-threatening with suicidal ideation

generalized_anxiety_disorder.typical_presentation: Excessive worry, restlessness, muscle tension, sleep disturbance, irritability
generalized_anxiety_disorder.notes: Common and often co-occurs with depression

avoid_or_caution: Drugs that lower seizure threshold (e.g., some antidepressants, tramadol)
epilepsy.notes: Many drug interactions; carbamazepine is a potent enzyme inducer

iron_deficiency_anemia.typical_presentation: Fatigue, weakness, pale skin, shortness of breath, cold hands/feet
avoid_or_caution: Calcium supplements (reduce iron absorption when taken together)
iron_deficiency_anemia.notes: Most common nutritional deficiency worldwide; investigate underlying cause

hiv.typical_presentation: Variable; may be asymptomatic or flu-like acute infection; long-term immunosuppression
hiv.notes: Effective ART allows near-normal life expectancy; extensive drug interaction profile

hepatitis_c.typical_presentation: Often asymptomatic; fatigue, jaundice, abdominal pain if symptomatic
hepatitis_c.notes: Now curable with direct-acting antivirals; liver disease progression without treatment

osteoporosis.typical_presentation: Often asymptomatic until fracture; vertebral, hip, and wrist fractures most common
osteoporosis.notes: Major cause of morbidity in elderly; hip fractures have high mortality

rheumatoid_arthritis.typical_presentation: Joint pain, swelling, stiffness (especially morning), symmetric pattern
rheumatoid_arthritis.notes: Autoimmune disease; can cause joint destruction and systemic complications
